title: Hyenas: More Than Scavengers
excerpt: Spotted hyenas are clever hunters, not just scavengers. Facts about their social life and their famous calls.
body:
## Hunters

Spotted hyenas hunt a large part of their own food.

## Clans

They live in clans led by females.

## Sounds

Their "whoop" call travels far. Their "laugh" is a sign of excitement or stress.

## Strong jaws

They can crush bones.

## Where

Almost every park, especially the Ngorongoro Crater and the Serengeti.

## Respect

Hyenas are important for a healthy ecosystem.
